weakness: No MFA on the accounting service, the dynamometer service, or the laptop administrator account; email MFA uses text-message codes
remediation_plan: Turn on accounting MFA; move email to an authenticator app; turn on dynamometer MFA with the tier change; recovery codes in the sealed envelope (POL-01 7.6)
milestones: 2026-09-15 accounting MFA on and tested; 2026-09-30 email authenticator app and sealed codes

weakness: Daily use of the laptop administrator account for email, web, and control work
remediation_plan: Create a standard daily account; keep the administrator account for installs only; IT technician confirms the configuration software runs from the standard account

weakness: Customer passwords in a plain synced spreadsheet; default and reused passwords; no change rule
source: P07 assessment (IA-05 objectives); P03 PR.AA-01; MSA-A (1)
remediation_plan: Password manager; move every credential and delete the spreadsheet and its file versions; change the router password now; list default device passwords and change them with each customer's approval
milestones: 2026-09-15 password manager in use and spreadsheet deleted; 2026-09-30 router changed and customer default list sent

weakness: No written terms for the Customer B remote path; security terms, controls, and responsibilities documented for Customer A only
remediation_plan: Ask Customer B for named accounts, MFA, and access only for scheduled sessions (sent 2026-07-24); add remote access terms at the Customer B renewal; record interface and contacts for each customer in the device and credential register
milestones: 2026-08-31 follow-up with Customer B; 2026-10-31 Customer B decision recorded and terms drafted

weakness: No offline backup of customer program copies or the laptop setup; no integrity check
source: P07 assessment (CP-09a. to CP-09d.[02]); P03 PR.DS-11
remediation_plan: Encrypted offline drive updated after each approved change and monthly; file hashes in the change log; written laptop rebuild steps; quarterly restore test
milestones: 2026-10-15 drive in use; 2026-10-31 first restore test and rebuild steps written

weakness: Logic and setpoint changes approved by phone and not recorded
source: P07 assessment (CM-03 objectives); P03 ID.RA-07; MSA-A (4)
remediation_plan: POL-01 8.4: email approval before each change and a change log with before and after versions; send each customer its approved program
milestones: 2026-09-15 change log started and every change approved by email from that date

weakness: Mixed-use USB drive; drives not scanned before use on customer equipment
remediation_plan: Two dedicated, labeled, encrypted program drives; scan before each site use; personal drive kept off customer equipment

weakness: No incident reporting time or contact list; 24-hour Customer A notice unknown
source: P07 assessment (IR-06 objectives); P03 RS.CO-02; MSA-A (3)
remediation_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and notification matrix; print the contact sheet; confirm Customer A's notice contact in writing; walk through the runbook with the IT technician
milestones: 2026-09-15 contact sheet printed and Customer A contact confirmed; 2026-09-30 walkthrough done
